target_description: Total waiting time in minutes from patient arrival to clinical consultation.

date.description: Patient arrival timestamp (M/D/YYYY H:MM format). Used to extract hour, day of week, and queue concurrency.

patient_gender.description: Biological sex of patient (M, F, NC).

patient_sat_score.description: Patient satisfaction rating recorded after visit (0-10). Excluded from prediction to prevent data leakage.

patient_admin_flag.description: Indicator if patient was admitted to inpatient bed or treated as outpatient. In live triage, mapped to urgency/priority.

patient_waittime.description: Actual waiting duration in minutes before consultation/care start. Target variable.

department_referral.description: Hospital department handling the patient visit (General Practice, Orthopedics, Cardiology, Neurology, Gastroenterology, Renal, Physiotherapy, or General Emergency if unreferred).
